commit.message:
Place controller bits safely and discharge the ordinary nonwrapping bound

Embed the actual power positions and optional cell three with exact finite cardinality and canonical no-wrap values. Bound every literal kernel term and the full coefficient mass, then use the existing high-prefix bound for the same F to prove the required ordinary increment fits below q minus one.

Construct the updated carry solution with both ordinary C/F equalities and the resulting exact rank decrement. Document independent full-source isolated replays, twenty-six standard-only audits and matching objects. Finite-support accumulation and final rank calibration remain separate.

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentControllerData2011
+
+/-! Safe physical positions for the actual controller power subset.
+These are ordinary natural bounds and exact cyclic embeddings. No dummy
+value, rank identity, or controller unit is a premise or conclusion. -/
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentControllerPositions2011
+
+open CurrentControllerData2011
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000
+
+def position (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) : ℕ :=
+  2+(auxiliary-1)*j.val
+
+def cell (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) : ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1)) :=
+  (position k j : ℕ)
+
+theorem position_pos (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) : 0 < position k j := by
+  unfold position
+  omega
+
+/-- A subtraction-free form of the sharp endpoint estimate. -/
+theorem position_budget (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) :
+    position k j+auxiliary^k+auxiliary ≤ auxiliary^(k+1)+3 := by
+  have hv : j.val+1 ≤ auxiliary^k := ZMod.val_lt j
+  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (auxiliary-1) hv
+  have hp : auxiliary^(k+1) = auxiliary^k*auxiliary := pow_succ _ _
+  have ha : auxiliary-1+1 = auxiliary := by decide
+  unfold position
+  nlinarith
+
+theorem position_max (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) :
+    position k j ≤ auxiliary^(k+1)-auxiliary^k-auxiliary+3 := by
+  have h := position_budget k j
+  omega
+
+theorem position_next_lt (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) :
+    position k j+1 < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  have h := position_budget k j
+  have ha : 4 ≤ auxiliary := by decide
+  have hp : 0 < auxiliary^k := pow_pos (NeZero.pos auxiliary) k
+  omega
+
+theorem position_lt (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) :
+    position k j < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  have h := position_next_lt k j
+  omega
+
+theorem stride_lt_orbit {rw k : ℕ} (hrw : rw < k) : auxiliary^rw < auxiliary^k :=
+  Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide : 1 < auxiliary) hrw
+
+theorem position_stride_lt {rw k : ℕ} (hrw : rw < k) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) :
+    position k j+auxiliary^rw < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  have h := position_budget k j
+  have hs := stride_lt_orbit hrw
+  have ha : 4 ≤ auxiliary := by decide
+  omega
+
+theorem optional_next_lt (k : ℕ) : 3+1 < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  have h : auxiliary ≤ auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+    simpa only [pow_one] using pow_le_pow_right'
+      (by decide : 1 ≤ auxiliary) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le k))
+  have ha : 4 < auxiliary := by decide
+  omega
+
+theorem optional_lt (k : ℕ) : 3 < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  have h := optional_next_lt k
+  omega
+
+theorem optional_stride_lt {rw k : ℕ} (hrw : rw < k) :
+    3+auxiliary^rw < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  have hs := stride_lt_orbit hrw
+  have hp : 0 < auxiliary^k := pow_pos (NeZero.pos auxiliary) k
+  have ha : 4 < auxiliary := by decide
+  rw [pow_succ]
+  nlinarith
+
+theorem position_injective (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (position k) := by
+  intro i j hij
+  apply ZMod.val_injective
+  have hp : 0 < auxiliary-1 := by decide
+  unfold position at hij
+  nlinarith
+
+theorem position_ne_three (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) : position k j ≠ 3 := by
+  intro h
+  have hp : 2 ≤ auxiliary-1 := by decide
+  unfold position at h
+  by_cases hz : j.val = 0
+  · simp [hz] at h
+  · have hj : 1 ≤ j.val := by omega
+    nlinarith
+
+theorem cell_val (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) : (cell k j).val = position k j :=
+  ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (position_lt k j)
+
+theorem cell_injective (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (cell k) := by
+  intro i j hij
+  apply position_injective k
+  simpa only [cell_val] using congrArg ZMod.val hij
+
+theorem cell_ne_three (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) : cell k j ≠ 3 := by
+  intro h
+  apply position_ne_three k j
+  calc
+    position k j = (cell k j).val := (cell_val k j).symm
+    _ = ((3 : ℕ) : ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1))).val := congrArg ZMod.val h
+    _ = 3 := ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (optional_lt k)
+
+/-- The actual finite support, with the optional cell selected iff ε≠0. -/
+def support (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) (ε : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
+  if ε = 0 then s.image (position k) else insert 3 (s.image (position k))
+
+theorem three_not_mem_image (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) :
+    3 ∉ s.image (position k) := by
+  intro h
+  obtain ⟨j,hj,he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
+  exact position_ne_three k j he
+
+theorem support_card (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k)))
+    (ε : ℕ) (hε : ε ≤ 1) : (support k s ε).card = s.card+ε := by
+  unfold support
+  split_ifs with h
+  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective s (position_injective k),h,Nat.add_zero]
+  · have he : ε = 1 := by omega
+    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (three_not_mem_image k s),
+      Finset.card_image_of_injective s (position_injective k),he]
+
+theorem support_mem (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) (ε n : ℕ) :
+    n ∈ support k s ε ↔ (∃ j ∈ s, position k j = n) ∨ (ε ≠ 0 ∧ n = 3) := by
+  by_cases h : ε = 0 <;> simp [support,h,or_comm]
+
+theorem support_basic (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) (ε n : ℕ)
+    (hn : n ∈ support k s ε) : 0 < n ∧ n+1 < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  rcases (support_mem k s ε n).mp hn with ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩ | ⟨hε,rfl⟩
+  · exact ⟨position_pos k j,position_next_lt k j⟩
+  · exact ⟨by decide,optional_next_lt k⟩
+
+/-- These safety bounds need only rw<k; the subset construction's stronger
+condition auxiliary^k>d*auxiliary is not required for position geometry. -/
+theorem support_safe {rw k : ℕ} (hrw : rw < k)
+    (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) (ε n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ support k s ε) :
+    0 < n ∧ n+1 < auxiliary^(k+1) ∧ n+auxiliary^rw < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  obtain ⟨hpos,hnext⟩ := support_basic k s ε n hn
+  refine ⟨hpos,hnext,?_⟩
+  rcases (support_mem k s ε n).mp hn with ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩ | ⟨hε,rfl⟩
+  · exact position_stride_lt hrw j
+  · exact optional_stride_lt hrw
+
+def cyclicSupport (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) (ε : ℕ) :
+    Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1))) :=
+  (support k s ε).image (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1))))
+
+theorem support_cast_injective (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) (ε : ℕ) :
+    Set.InjOn (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1)))) (support k s ε) := by
+  intro a ha b hb he
+  have hla : a < auxiliary^(k+1) := by have h := (support_basic k s ε a ha).2; omega
+  have hlb : b < auxiliary^(k+1) := by have h := (support_basic k s ε b hb).2; omega
+  simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hla,ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hlb] using
+    congrArg ZMod.val he
+
+theorem cyclicSupport_card (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k)))
+    (ε : ℕ) (hε : ε ≤ 1) : (cyclicSupport k s ε).card = s.card+ε := by
+  rw [cyclicSupport,Finset.card_image_of_injOn (support_cast_injective k s ε)]
+  exact support_card k s ε hε
+
+/-- This is directly in the value form consumed by the dummy safety API. -/
+theorem cyclicSupport_safe {rw k : ℕ} (hrw : rw < k)
+    (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) (ε : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1)))
+    (hj : j ∈ cyclicSupport k s ε) :
+    0 < j.val ∧ j.val+1 < auxiliary^(k+1) ∧ j.val+auxiliary^rw < auxiliary^(k+1) := by
+  obtain ⟨n,hn,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
+  have hb := support_safe hrw s ε n hn
+  have hl : n < auxiliary^(k+1) := by omega
+  simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hl] using hb
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.CurrentControllerPositions2011

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentControllerPositions2011
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentControllerPositions2011Checks
+
+open CurrentControllerData2011 CurrentControllerPositions2011
+set_option Elab.async false
+
+example (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (cell k) := cell_injective k
+example (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) : cell k j ≠ 3 := cell_ne_three k j
+example (k : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^k)) :
+    position k j ≤ auxiliary^(k+1)-auxiliary^k-auxiliary+3 := position_max k j
+
+-- The one-point orbit k=0 still embeds at position2, disjoint from3.
+example (j : ZMod (auxiliary^0)) : position 0 j = 2 := by
+  have h : j.val < 1 := ZMod.val_lt j
+  have hz : j.val = 0 := by omega
+  unfold position
+  rw [hz,Nat.mul_zero,Nat.add_zero]
+example : (support 0 ∅ 1).card = 1 := by
+  simpa only [Finset.card_empty,Nat.zero_add] using support_card 0 ∅ 1 (by decide)
+example : (cyclicSupport 0 ∅ 0).card = 0 := by
+  simpa only [Finset.card_empty,Nat.zero_add] using cyclicSupport_card 0 ∅ 0 (by decide)
+
+-- The finite subset preserves cardinality, including optional3.
+example (k : ℕ) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k))) :
+    (cyclicSupport k s 1).card = s.card+1 := cyclicSupport_card k s 1 (by decide)
+
+-- Both actual successors are below N, not just congruent modulo N.
+example {rw k : ℕ} (hrw : rw < k) (s : Finset (ZMod (auxiliary^k)))
+    (ε : ℕ) (j : ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1))) (hj : j ∈ cyclicSupport k s ε) :
+    0 < j.val ∧ j.val+1 < auxiliary^(k+1) ∧ j.val+auxiliary^rw < auxiliary^(k+1) :=
+  cyclicSupport_safe hrw s ε j hj
+
+#print axioms position_budget
+#print axioms position_max
+#print axioms position_next_lt
+#print axioms position_stride_lt
+#print axioms optional_stride_lt
+#print axioms position_injective
+#print axioms cell_injective
+#print axioms cell_ne_three
+#print axioms support_card
+#print axioms support_safe
+#print axioms support_cast_injective
+#print axioms cyclicSupport_card
+#print axioms cyclicSupport_safe
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.CurrentControllerPositions2011Checks

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentDummyMutation2011
+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordTopBounds2011
+
+/-!
+# A sufficient physical safety bound for one actual dummy update
+
+Only the two canonical position inequalities are assumed. A coarse bound on
+the complete literal kernel is enough; no coefficient-collision enumeration
+or high-mask premise is needed. The old normalized word remains the original
+one throughout the ordinary transport and rank equalities.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentDummySafety2011
+
+open CurrentMasks2011 CurrentWordConstruction2011 CurrentWordClause2011
+  CurrentDummyMutation2011 NativeRankVariation
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+theorem kernel_exponent_le (t : CurrentKernel2011.Term) :
+    CurrentKernel2011.exponent t ≤ 2020 := by
+  rcases t with j | e
+  · fin_cases j <;> decide
+  · change 1005-CurrentKernel2011.position e ≤ 2020
+    omega
+
+private theorem weighted_powers_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
+    (ρ : ℕ) (c e : α → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ) (he : ∀ i, e i ≤ L) :
+    (∑ i, c i*ρ^(e i)) ≤ (∑ i, c i)*ρ^L := by
+  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
+  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+  intro i _
+  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hρ (he i))
+
+/-- The actual total coefficient mass is tiny relative to radix squared. -/
+theorem kernel_upper_bound : CurrentKernel2011.K < radix^2022 := by
+  have h := weighted_powers_le radix CurrentKernel2011.coefficient
+    CurrentKernel2011.exponent 2020 (by decide) kernel_exponent_le
+  rw [CurrentKernel2011.coefficient_mass] at h
+  change CurrentKernel2011.K ≤ 7659829036801887*radix^2020 at h
+  calc
+    CurrentKernel2011.K ≤ 7659829036801887*radix^2020 := h
+    _ < radix^2*radix^2020 :=
+      Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by decide) (pow_pos (by decide) _)
+    _ = radix^2022 := by rw [← pow_add]
+
+attribute [local irreducible] CurrentKernel2011.K
+
+theorem displacement_power (s : ℕ) : 2^(displacement s) = radix^(2011*s) := by
+  unfold displacement CurrentMasks2011.radix
+  rw [pow_mul]
+
+theorem dummyIncrement_power {N : ℕ} (j : ZMod N) :
+    dummyIncrement j = radix^(977+2011*j.val) := by
+  rw [dummyIncrement, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
+
+theorem temporal_dummy_power {N : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (j : ZMod N) :
+    2^(displacement s)*dummyIncrement j = radix^(977+2011*(j.val+s)) := by
+  rw [displacement_power, dummyIncrement_power, ← pow_add]
+  congr 1
+  omega
+
+theorem kernel_dummy_bound {N : ℕ} (j : ZMod N) :
+    CurrentKernel2011.K*dummyIncrement j < radix^(2999+2011*j.val) := by
+  rw [dummyIncrement_power]
+  calc
+    CurrentKernel2011.K*radix^(977+2011*j.val) <
+        radix^2022*radix^(977+2011*j.val) :=
+      Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right kernel_upper_bound (pow_pos (by decide) _)
+    _ = radix^(2999+2011*j.val) := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
+
+/-- These inequalities use the actual canonical cell representative.
+They allow stride zero but exclude a one-cell modulus or a final-cell update. -/
+theorem safe_exponent_bounds {N : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (j : ZMod N)
+    (hnext : j.val+1 < N) (htime : j.val+s < N) :
+    4022 ≤ N*2011 ∧ 2999+2011*j.val ≤ N*2011-1023 ∧
+      977+2011*(j.val+s) ≤ N*2011-1034 := by
+  omega
+
+/-- A positive ordinary increment with two whole high fields to spare.
+This numerical result does not assume a word, Boolean controls, or carries. -/
+theorem safe_increment_bound {N : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (j : ZMod N)
+    (hnext : j.val+1 < N) (htime : j.val+s < N) :
+    0 < (CurrentKernel2011.K+2^(displacement s))*dummyIncrement j ∧
+      (CurrentKernel2011.K+2^(displacement s))*dummyIncrement j < radix^(N*2011-2) := by
+  obtain ⟨hm,hkexp,htexp⟩ := safe_exponent_bounds s j hnext htime
+  have hbase : 1 ≤ radix := by decide
+  have hk : CurrentKernel2011.K*dummyIncrement j < radix^(N*2011-3) :=
+    (kernel_dummy_bound j).trans_le
+      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega))
+  have ht : 2^(displacement s)*dummyIncrement j ≤ radix^(N*2011-3) := by
+    rw [temporal_dummy_power]
+    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega)
+  constructor
+  · have hp : 0 < 2^(displacement s) := pow_pos (by decide) _
+    exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (dummyIncrement_pos j)
+  · rw [Nat.add_mul]
+    calc
+      CurrentKernel2011.K*dummyIncrement j+2^(displacement s)*dummyIncrement j <
+          2*radix^(N*2011-3) := by omega
+      _ ≤ radix^(N*2011-2) := by
+        have he : N*2011-2 = (N*2011-3)+1 := by omega
+        rw [he,pow_succ]
+        simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using
+          Nat.mul_le_mul_right (radix^(N*2011-3)) (by decide : 2 ≤ radix)
+
+/-- The same bound expressed with the actual whole-word quotient. -/
+theorem safe_increment_div_bound {N : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (j : ZMod N)
+    (hnext : j.val+1 < N) (htime : j.val+s < N) :
+    (CurrentKernel2011.K+2^(displacement s))*dummyIncrement j < radix^(N*2011)/radix^2 := by
+  have hm := (safe_exponent_bounds s j hnext htime).1
+  have he : N*2011 = (N*2011-2)+2 := by omega
+  have hq : radix^(N*2011)/radix^2 = radix^(N*2011-2) := by
+    conv_lhs => rw [he,pow_add]
+    exact Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (pow_pos (by decide) _)
+  rw [hq]
+  exact (safe_increment_bound s j hnext htime).2
+
+private theorem nonwrap_of_short {ρ m F δ : ℕ} (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
+    (hF : F < ρ^(m-1)) (hδ : δ < ρ^(m-2)) : F+δ < ρ^m-1 := by
+  have he1 : m-1 = (m-2)+1 := by omega
+  have he2 : m = (m-2)+2 := by omega
+  have hp : 0 < ρ^(m-2) := pow_pos (by omega) _
+  have hc : ρ+1 < ρ^2 := by nlinarith
+  have hq : ρ^m = ρ^(m-2)*ρ^2 := by conv_lhs => rw [he2,pow_add]
+  rw [he1,pow_succ] at hF
+  have hl : F+δ+2 ≤ ρ^(m-2)*(ρ+1) := by nlinarith
+  have hr : ρ^(m-2)*(ρ+1) < ρ^m := by
+    rw [hq]
+    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc hp
+  have := hl.trans_lt hr
+  omega
+
+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
+
+/-- Discharge the mutation's nonwrapping premise for the original actual F. -/
+theorem normalized_nonwrap_of_safe (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy marker : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ i, dummy i ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ i, marker i ≤ 1) (s : ℕ)
+    (j : ZMod N) (hnext : j.val+1 < N) (htime : j.val+s < N)
+    (carry digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy marker) (displacement s) carry digits) :
+    NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix digits+
+      (CurrentKernel2011.K+2^(displacement s))*dummyIncrement j < radix^(N*2011)-1 := by
+  exact nonwrap_of_short (by decide)
+    (by have := (safe_exponent_bounds s j hnext htime).1; omega)
+    (CurrentWordTopBounds2011.normalized_word_top_bound a dummy marker hd hm s carry digits hf)
+    (safe_increment_bound s j hnext htime).2
+
+/-- Any two actual normalizations give the exact ordinary F increment at
+a safe unused dummy; no nonwrapping bound is supplied. -/
+theorem safe_normalized_increment (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy marker : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ i, dummy i ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ i, marker i ≤ 1) (s : ℕ)
+    (j : ZMod N) (hj : dummy j = 0) (hnext : j.val+1 < N) (htime : j.val+s < N)
+    (carry digits carry' digits' : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy marker) (displacement s) carry digits)
+    (hf' : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a (Function.update dummy j 1) marker)
+        (displacement s) carry' digits') :
+    NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix digits' = NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix digits+
+      (CurrentKernel2011.K+2^(displacement s))*dummyIncrement j :=
+  normalized_increment a dummy marker hd hm s j hj carry digits carry' digits' hf hf'
+    (normalized_nonwrap_of_safe a dummy marker hd hm s j hnext htime carry digits hf)
+
+/-- Construct the new normalization and retain both ordinary word equalities. -/
+theorem exists_safe_normalized_increment (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy marker : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ i, dummy i ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ i, marker i ≤ 1) (s : ℕ)
+    (j : ZMod N) (hj : dummy j = 0) (hnext : j.val+1 < N) (htime : j.val+s < N)
+    (carry digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy marker) (displacement s) carry digits) :
+    ∃ carry' digits' : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ,
+      CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+        (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a (Function.update dummy j 1) marker)
+          (displacement s) carry' digits' ∧
+      NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix
+          (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a (Function.update dummy j 1) marker) =
